Summary: After 1,500 years waiting for Arthur's return, Merlin finally gets him back. However, the weight of a life defined by waiting, drowning in loneliness and protecting Arthur at the cost of losing himself has left him angry, exhausted and deeply depressed. Combined with an ancient prophecy Arthur now knows the truth about and a new threat rising on the horizon, everything they have fought for is at risk of falling apart. Can they face this new danger while struggling to understand what they truly mean to one another?
